newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish air cargo up 10.5 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Spanish air cargo up 10.5 pct in April.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at the 39 airports managed by AENA (Spanish Airports and Air Navegation), rose 10.5 percent in April to 43,094 tonnes, AENA said.
Strong growth in traffic at Palma de Mallorca and Madrid boosted the total. Cargo business at Palma rose 35.0 percent to 1,933 tonnes while Madrid handled 14.8 percent more cargo, or 22,093 tonnes.

The accumulated total for the first four months of the year was approximately 180,109 tonnes, based on these provisional figures, up 11.6 percent from the 161,444 tonnes handled in the same period 1996.

Passenger numbers at all the AENA airports climbed 5.7 percent last month to 8.86 million and the number of aircraft movements was up 9.9 percent to 121,863. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
